tripAdvisorReviews.name: hub by Premier Inn London Tower Bridge hotel
tripAdvisorReviews.address: 28 Great Tower Street, London EC3R 5AT England

reviews.title: Good value stay
reviews.text:
Good choice for a short stay when you don't need a luxury hotel experience. 
Good location a few minutes walk from the Tower of London and Tower Hill tube station.
Room was small, spotlessly clean with a  comfortable bed and decent TV. The bed was enclosed on one side and at each end so looked a bit like a single layer bunk bed. It was slightly higher than a normal bed to provide storage space below.
Felt very safe as hotel card needed to access guest stairs and lifts. 
Plenty of hot water came from shower which had a normal shower head and a "rainmaker/drench" head.
Breakfast was limited with the only hot food being porridge and toast. Other options were cereal, pastries, fruit and yoghurt. Everything was self service including tea or coffee.
For my needs, which were a decent bed for the night and something to eat before leaving, it was ideal and good value.

reviews.title: Highly recommended- Excellent Hub and Staff
reviews.text: The hub is in a great location with lots on its doorstep, has a very relaxing atmosphere, is clean and tidy, and our room 614 was lovely with a great view across the Thames!, the hub team were extremely friendly and helpful with Sarva Zaheer, being a standout member of staff who was lovely and helpful, making our stay that much more enjoyable!!, thank you so much Sarva!!, you’re a star!! 🌟, we have had a lovely stay and without a shadow of a doubt will be back to stay again in the near future!!

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text:
Very welcoming & polite staff (sarva & Angelia) . Crossiants were super fresh & tasty. 
Unlimited continental breakfast for a reasonable price. Hot chocolate was creamy. 
Would definitely return & recommend. 
Peaceful atmostphere considering it’s in London.

reviews.title: Very friendly, helpful staff
reviews.text: I’ve stayed a few times and always give this Hub a top rating. Very clean, quiet and convenient, and on this occasion the service particularly stood out. A very warm welcome from the two lovely, helpful girls on reception, and a super friendly greeting at breakfast. It’s so nice to be around people who are working hard with such a positive attitude!

reviews.title: Excellent staff and accommodation
reviews.text: Excellent accommodation lovely and modern. All staff were very well mannered and very friendly.Rooms were fantastic, and the location was spot on for getting around. Would highly recommend it if you are visiting London. I was on business but would definitely book again.
